source_units.text: I have to evaluate a workstation mock-up in a human-factors class.
Set out a short study timetable.
Use the exact labels "Display Legibility", "Control Compatibility", "Workstation Reach" in the schedule, with at least 25 total minutes assigned to each.
Within that coverage, "Display Legibility" needs at least 35 total minutes.
There is a firm ceiling of 40 study minutes on each date.
The last usable study date is 2027-02-03, and sessions may fall on that day.
